speaker: Damián（VO）
cn: 现在记录节点？
en: Recording a fate-node now?

speaker: 戒指（OS）
cn: （低沉，带回声）命运馈赠——三百万美元已至，款项即刻转入继承者账户。
en: Fate’s offering—three million dollars, now deposited into the heir’s account.

speaker: Samanta
cn: 放开我！
en: Let me go!

speaker: Damián
cn: （拍了拍手）我知道你对我和我爸有意见，但你们家的钱我们真的不稀罕！
en: I know you’ve got a problem with me and my dad, but trust me, we’re not interested in your family’s money!

speaker: Isadora
cn: Samanta你真的误会了，是我主动提出和Damián结婚的！他之前不知道我的身份！
en: Samanta, this is a misunderstanding. I proposed marriage to Damián! He didn't know my identity before.

speaker: Samanta
cn: （抱怨）随便你们吧！我不管你们了！
en: (Grumbling) Do whatever you want! It's none of my business.

speaker: Isadora
cn: Damián对不起，我不应该瞒着你的。
en: Damián, I'm sorry—I should have told you about my identity before.

speaker: Damián
cn: （笑）没事的，我能理解，Samanta那么年轻，却能把公司打理得那么好，性格肯定很谨慎的。
en: (laughs) It’s fine. I understand. Samanta’s managed to run a company this well at such a young age. Of course she’s going to be cautious

speaker: Isadora
cn: （疑惑）什么？（反应过来，掩饰）对，她做总裁太累了，所以脾气不好。
en: (confused) What? (quickly covering) Oh, right. Being the CEO is exhausting. That’s why she can be a little short-tempered.

speaker: Isadora（VO ）
cn: Samanta先辛苦你做一下总裁啦！
en: Samanta, guess you have to be the CEO for a bit!

speaker: Damián（VO）
cn: 我不能让Isadora的家人继续误解我，况且我还欠她一枚戒指，刚才获得的三百万美元我全都拿出来给Isadora挑一枚好看的戒指吧。
en: I can’t let Isadora’s family keep getting the wrong idea about me. Besides, I still owe her a ring. I’ll spend every penny of that three million on the perfect ring for her.

speaker: 店员
cn: （小声打电话）Eloísa，我在珠宝店到Damián了！（悄悄偷瞄Damián，表情兴奋）Eloísa，Damián是不是要跟你求婚啊！
en: (murmuring on the phone) Eloísa, I saw Damián at the jewelry store! (glances covertly at Damián with an excited expression) Is Damián going to propose to you?

speaker: Eloísa(VO)
cn: （得意）你帮我看看他买的什么款式？
en: (smiling) Can you check which one he bought?

speaker: 店员
cn: （羡慕）是最新款的真爱天使！要三百万美元呢！
en: (Envious) It’s the latest True Love Angel design! It’s worth three million dollars!

speaker: Eloísa
cn: 我就知道Damián还爱着我！先把Damián手里三百万美元的钻戒骗到手，之前那个太便宜了，我都看不上。
en: I knew Damián still loves me! I’ll get that three-million-dollar diamond ring out of him first. The last one was so cheap, I wouldn’t even look twice at it.

speaker: Eloísa（坏笑）
cn: 在此之前得先给他点教训！
en: But first, I need to teach him a lesson!

speaker: Luis
cn: （不满）Damián才上班几天就迟到？
en: (Unhappy) Damián’s only been here a few days, and he’s already showing up late?

speaker: Luis
cn: （轻咳一声，移开视线）这个Damián，在我眼皮子底下乱搞男女关系！哪怕总裁赏识他，我也不会放过他的！
en: (Coughs lightly, shifting his gaze away) Damián’s messing around with women at work, right under my nose! I don’t care if he’s the CEO’s favorite. I’m not letting this slide!

speaker: Damián
cn: （看Luis）部长，不好意思，我来晚了。
en: (Looking at Luis) Mr. Luis, so sorry, I'm a bit late.

speaker: Luis
cn: Damián，上班第三天就迟到两个小时？扣钱！来我办公室！
en: Damián, it's only your third day, and you're already two hours late? I’m docking your pay. My office. Now.

speaker: 员工一
cn: （疑惑）部长怎么了？他以前对迟到也没这么严格啊！
en: (Confused) What’s gotten into Luis? He’s never been this strict about tardiness before.

speaker: 员工二
cn: （小声）我早上看到Eloísa进了部长办公室，她出来后，部长就开始查迟到了。
en: (murmuring) I saw Eloísa enter Luis's office this morning. The second she came out, he suddenly started cracking down on tardiness.

speaker: 员工一
cn: （祈祷）希望组长没事。
en: (Praying) I hope the team lead is okay.

speaker: Luis
cn: 这是我最近跟进的项目，你想办法搞定。不然，自己离开！
en: This is a project I’ve been working on. Figure out how to get it done. If you can’t, pack your things and get out.
